verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee exposes explicit controls for when content is returned versus latency: wait_for CSS/XPath selector to block until content loads, JS scenarios for custom interactions before return, block_ads/block_resources to speed up requests, and an 'auto' mode that picks the cheapest/fastest working configuration. These parameters let a developer directly trade off completeness (waiting for full rendering) against latency (blocking resources, skipping waits).
